Because the production logic still assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage`, the newly added tests in `usageAggregation.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`) or add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Only the acceptance tests and the partial update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` were delivered.
